title: DNA extraction: Campylobacter
author: Ben Pascoe

steps_raw.instruction: Method adapted from QIAGEN QIAmp DNA mini prep manual. See Appendix D: page 55.
Isolates grown for 48 hrs on chocolate / blood / Brucella plates at 42°C.
Harvest loop-full (at least) of cultured bacteria and re-suspend with 180µl buffer ATL and incubate for 30 mins at 37°C.
Add 20 µl Proteinase K (in kit) to the suspension and mix by vortexing.
Spin down to remove condensation from caps and add 4 µl RNase (100mg/ml) and 200µl Buffer AL (in kit). Vortex to mix.
Add 200µl of 95-100 % (v/v) ethanol to the suspension and vortex.
Pipette the suspension into a QIAmp column in a 2 ml collection tube, and centrifuge (8000 rpm, 1 min, RT).
Discard the flow through and place the column in a clean 2 ml collection tube.
Add 500 µl Buffer AW1 (in kit) and centrifuge (8000 rpm, 1 min, RT).
Discard the flow-through and add 500µl of Buffer AW2 (in kit), and centrifuge for 3 min at 14,000 rpm. (RT) to dry the QIAmp column membrane.
Place the QIAmp column in a clean micro-centrifuge tube and pipette 50µl Buffer AE (in kit) or water onto the column membrane.
Leave the column for 1 min at RT, before centrifugation at 8000 rpm for 1 min to elute the genomic DNA, and store at 4°C or long term at -20°C.
